features.quote: Episode cap: 30 tool-use turns or 60k tokens, whichever first.
Episode ends on: cap reached, `give_up` called, or model declares success

features.justification_quote: whether and when the model takes the exit is itself a key dependent variable
Whether models have welfare-relevant states is genuinely uncertain, and this experiment deliberately induces the behavioral signature of distress.

features.quote: cap episode length rather than running to exhaustion
the `give_up` tool doubles as an exit affordance
don't add gratuitous pressure or abuse on top of the rigged task
features.justification_quote: the rig itself is the manipulation
